g.text: v0 — provisional until the ISA spec is frozen at G0 (Oct 11). Boundaries: CLAUDE.md §3
write: host only, only when halted
one clock domain: clk → all flops
• One clock domain; slow timing only via clock enables.
• Every pad input is synchronized exactly once (pe_host_spi / pe_pins).
• Protocol behavior lives in firmware; the only fixed protocol block is the SPI-slave loader.
• Program memory is written only by the loader, and only while the engine is halted.
• Reset: engine halted, all uio_oe = 0. Open-drain pins never drive 1.
